scope: template-render/v1 failure-evidence candidate, prospective qualification, exact canary promotion and causal rollback
implemented: Current Goals Host capabilities derive failure evidence and exact owner-run proofs from stable owner, route, Goal, receipt and raw Session-event snapshots.
Workflow and canary traces accept only calls strictly after the exact Goal source and before the completed turn end, with original append results that cite exactly the matching call sequence.
Failure candidates bind the independently not-achieved trigger, later independently achieved repair, parent, permission delta and rollback target without accepting caller-supplied evidence.
template-render/v1 freezes a CSPRNG prospective dataset only after scope, baseline, candidate, budget and exact canary admission are bound.
The admission binds parent and candidate definition digests plus the Goal definition and independent outcome profile used by later canary observations.
Only one exact successful skill_run in the raw Goal trace may supply promotion or rollback evidence; standalone watches remain observation-only.
Candidate, watch, deployment and canary mutation responses expose explicit public projections rather than owner routes, raw provenance, Session identifiers, receipts, observations or run IDs.

The zero-model negative control is executable, intentionally fails at least one strict one-pass template case, passes at least one control case and is single-sourced by the prompt, guard and exact-run assertion.

assistantSkills.realDockerConsumer: real prospective CLI qualification enters canary once and retries without another authority process

zeroModelGuard.command: VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 pnpm exec vitest run tests/web-owner-real-guard.spec.ts --reporter=verbose

fullCheck.result: manifest, zero-warning lint, workspace typecheck/tests, final build and dry-run packs passed

realModelE2e.reason: The prior full-chain run consumed roughly one million model tokens per attempt according to a local Trae state-database estimate; model.jsonl cannot independently confirm the estimate because its ACP settlements report usage:null. Each DSH model call starts a fresh ACP session with the complete context and tool schemas. After diagnosing and fixing the deterministic negative-input drift, this batch intentionally stopped further full-chain model reruns. No success is inferred without a new proof.json from the exact final source and required route.

failedAttempts.reason: The run reached a promoted deployment, but its negative skill_run arguments differed from the guard's pinned template-render input. The guard correctly denied the call before a SkillRun was persisted, so the unrelated not-achieved Goal could not authorize rollback. The harness now uses task.negativeInputs as the single source and has a zero-model semantic regression; this failed run is not completion evidence.

independentReview.preFixReview: Found and corrected two source-window causal gaps and one model-visible projection leak; found no blocker in exact canary admission or qualified rollback authority.
independentReview.finalReview: PASS: independent Goals and Skills security reviews found zero blocker, high or medium findings after source-window and complete public-output projection fixes; independent evidence review found no remaining factual inconsistency after final log and count reconciliation.

limitations: This is one controlled template-render task family, not the required three to five real high-frequency workflow classes.
The real Docker prospective qualification and synthetic fresh-outcome lifecycle passed, but no post-fix full real-TraeX proof exists.
A passing zero-model guard proves deterministic test input and security policy, not general model reliability or real-task gain.
This batch does not validate real GitHub, signed production publication, installation upgrade, another deployment type or the complete WP13-WP15 scope.
Private retained profiles, holdout cases, keys and authority databases are not published.
